channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Drone strikes power station near Libya’s largest oil refinery
item.description: A drone has struck a power station in Libya’s western city of Zawiya

item.title: Oil prices rise as attacks dent hopes for Strait of Hormuz reopening
item.description: Brent crude climbs as renewed violence dampens hopes for a return to stability in energy markets.

item.title: Six killed in Houthi attack on Bab al-Mandeb ship, Yemen’s government says
item.description: Deaths on Egyptian-owned Tihamah mark first shipping deaths linked to Houthis since the US-Israel war on Iran began.

item.title: Iran holds firm on Hormuz conditions as Pakistan’s Naqvi visits Tehran
item.description: Iran's top security official says the Strait of Hormuz will not reopen unless the US meets its conditions.

item.title: N Korea launches ballistic missile as S Korea, US plan military drills
item.description: Pyongyang conducts second weapons test in less than a week as Seoul, Washington gear up for annual military exercises.

item.title: Iran war live: Trump claims US in ‘total control’ of Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Qatar says negotiations between Oman, Iran over future of shipping through Strait of Hormuz are making major progress.

item.title: Cargo ship in flames after Houthi attack in Bab al-Mandeb strait
item.description: Footage shows an Egyptian-owned cargo vessel in flames in the Bab al-Mandeb strait after a suspected Houthi attack.

item.title: Colombia scrambles to find survivors after deadly earthquake
item.description: At least 254 deaths have been reported so far, as rescue workers continue to sift through collapsed buildings.

item.title: Pakistan interior minister in Tehran amid talks to reopen Hormuz
item.description: Pakistan’s interior minister Mohsin Naqvi has held talks with Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi in Tehran.

item.title: Israel demolishes home of Palestinian killed during settler attack
item.description: Video shows the moment Israeli forces blow up the home of Farouk Ramadan, a Palestinian man who was killed in July.
